failure_modes.name: Entity_Coreference_Error
failure_modes.evidence: The claim states 'He also had a role in the TV series Carl Levitt.' The solver interprets this as claiming Max Gail played the character Carl Levitt, stating: 'The claim states Max Gail "had a role in the TV series Carl Levitt," which is factually incorrect. According to Passage [2], "Carl Levitt" is not a TV series title—it is a character name.' However, a more charitable reading is that the claim conflates 'Barney Miller' (the series) with 'Carl Levitt' (the character), treating them as co-referent.
